# LEDGER-011 classification -> mechanism -> state
STANDARD -> mechanism=OVERWRITE state=PAYLOAD_ERASED
ENCRYPTED_AT_REST -> mechanism=CRYPTO_ERASURE state=RESTRICTED
# unrecognized classifications are refused, never defaulted
"" -> error=true
"standard" -> error=true
"ENCRYPTED" -> error=true
"TOP_SECRET" -> error=true
# declared PayloadState vocabulary
PRESENT
REFERENCED
HELD
RESTRICTED
PAYLOAD_ERASED
